description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped model layer ranges for several methods, with multiple colored lines and a dashed baseline shown together. The x-axis is labeled with categorical layer groups (visible labels include “Layer13–20,” “Layer21–28,” and “Layer29…”), arranged left to right; earlier layer-group labels are partially cut off on the left, and there are no numeric units on this axis. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with tick labels at approximately 5%, 0%, −5%, and −15% (percent units). A gray dashed line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” increases steadily from near 0% at the leftmost group to around 5% at the rightmost group. A yellow solid line with circular markers labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” rises gradually across the layer groups, starting slightly above 0% on the left and reaching roughly 5% at the rightmost group. A light-blue solid line with circular markers labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” starts near 0%, increases to a small positive value by the next group, dips below 0% around “Layer13–20,” then climbs sharply to a positive value near the upper range (around 4–5%) by “Layer21–28” and remains near that level at the rightmost group. A dark-blue solid line with square markers labeled “RULER4k of 1×…” begins slightly below 0%, rises to a small positive value by the next group, drops to its lowest point near −15% at “Layer13–20,” then increases to a positive value around a few percent by “Layer21–28” and ends higher (still below the topmost lines) at the rightmost group. A red solid line with square markers (label partially visible, beginning with “LB…”) increases from a small positive value on the left to higher positive values across the groups, with a modest rise through “Layer13–20” and reaching roughly 4–5% by the rightmost group.
